name: Arden Myrin
bio: Arden VanAmringe Myrin (born December 10, 1973) is an American actress and comedian. She's known for her role of Regina Sinclair on the Netflix series Insatiable, and starred in the world premiere of Steve Martin's play Meteor Shower at the Long Wharf Theatre. Her television credits include Insecure, Grey's Anatomy, Conan, Orange Is the New Black, Hung, Key & Peele, Inside Amy Schumer, W/ Bob & David, Psych, Bones, Fresh Off the Boat, Suburgatory, 2 Broke Girls, Reno 911!, Shameless, and Gilmore Girls.
